 November 16, 2026 Facebook X Linkedin Email Print NOTICE OF GENERAL RUNOFF ELECTION 
 CROSS COUNTY, ARKANSAS 
 DECEMBER 1, 2026 
 EARLY VOTING 
 Cross County Courthouse Tues.-Wed., Nov 24-25 8:00 a.m.—4:30 p.m. 
 Election Annex Bldg. Fri., Nov 27 8:00 a.m.—4:30 p.m. 
 704 E. Canal, Wynne Mon., Nov 30 8:00 a.m.—4:30 p.m. 
 ELECTION DAY VOTING 
 ELECTION DAY VOTING Tues., Dec. 1 7:30 a.m.—7:30 p.m. 
 VOTE CENTER LOCATIONS: Courthouse Annex Bldg. 704 E. Canal, Wynne 
 First Baptist Church—Parkin 234 E. Smithdale Ave, Parkin 
 VOTERS MAY VOTE Cherry Valley Baptist
Fellowship Building 112 Dexter, Cherry Valley 
 AT ANY VOTE CENTER Hickory Ridge City Hall CLOSED 
 Vanndale Fire Dept. CLOSED 
 Fair Oaks Assembly Church CLOSED 
 ABSENTEE VOTING: Qualified voters may request a ballot from the office of the County Clerk, (870) 238-5735 , ext. 4
 YOU MAY VIEW YOUR BALLOT ONLINE AT www.voterview.ar-nova.org 
 BALLOT RACES 
 WYNNE MAYOR PARKIN CITY COUNCIL WARD 1 POS 2 
 De’Andra L Warren Jestan Hopkins, Sr. 
 Mayor Jennifer Hobbs Sherry Wooten Gillon 
 CHERRY VALLEY MAYOR PARKIN CITY COUNCIL WARD 3 POS 2 
 Brett Stephens Diane Patterson 
 Christy Phillips Jimmy Robinson, Sr. 
 BALLOT PROCESSING 
 ACTIVITY LOCATION DATE TIME 
 Canvassing and Processing of Absentee Ballots Courthouse Annex 12/01 12:00 p.m. 
 Counting of Early Vote and Absentee Ballots Circuit Courtroom 12/01 7:30 p.m. 
 Compiling & Publishing Unofficial Election Results Circuit Courtroom 12/01 7:30 p.m. 
 Review of Provisional Ballots Courthouse Annex 12/02 1:00 p.m. 
 Provisional Ballot Hearing and Certification Courthouse Annex 12/07 5:30 p.m. 
 Election Officials appointed to conduct Early Voting, Election Day Voting, and all other required duties were posted for viewing in the office of the County Clerk on October 12. An objection must be filed in writing with the County Clerk if an official is a spouse of a county election commissioner, a county party chair, or spouse of a county party chair within 7 days of October 12. An objection that an official is a candidate’s spouse or related by blood within two degrees must be filed within 10 days of October 12.
 CROSS COUNTY BOARD OF ELECTION COMMISSIONERS
